entities.summary: Daniel Henry Chamberlain was an American planter, lawyer, author and the 76th governor of South Carolina from 1874 until 1876 or 1877. The federal government withdrew troops from the state and ended Reconstruction that year. Chamberlain was the last Republican governor of South Carolina until James B. Edwards was elected in 1974.
